channel.title: Hastings Daily: Crime & courts
channel.description: Local news for Hastings, St Leonards, Rye, Bexhill and Battle, three times a day.

item.title: Former Bexhill teacher jailed for raping and sexually assaulting a child
item.description: A former teacher from Bexhill has been jailed for raping and sexually assaulting a child, Sussex Police said.

item.title: Man charged with theft after evading police across railway line at Rye
item.description: A 45-year-old man has been charged with theft after stealing alcohol worth £130 from Jempsons supermarket at Rye.

item.title: Police seek man over theft of cash from Bexhill M&S
item.description: Sussex Police is seeking a man in connection with the theft of cash from the Marks and Spencer store in Ravenside Retail Park, Bexhill.

item.title: Two men charged with murder of Bexhill cyclist
item.description: Two men have appeared at Lewes Crown Court, charged with the murder of a Bexhill cyclist, Sussex Police have said.

item.title: Police launch manhunt for man wanted for recall to prison
item.description: Police have launched a manhunt for a man wanted for recall to prison and are asking anyone who sees him to call 999.

item.title: Two Sussex police officers charged over assault of detained man
item.description: Two Sussex Police officers have been charged with assault occasioning actual bodily harm over an incident involving a man detained in hospital under the Mental Health Act, according to the Independent Office for Police Conduct (IOPC).

item.title: Driver jailed for 13 months after 104mph police pursuit ended in ditch
item.description: A disqualified driver has been jailed for 13 months after leading police on a 31-minute pursuit through Hastings, Winchelsea and Rye that ended in a ditch in Iden.

item.title: Man pleads guilty to shoplifting across Hastings and Rother
item.description: A 45-year-old man from Winchelsea Beach has been charged in connection with a series of shop theft offences across Hastings and Rother.

item.title: Car wash owner sentenced over illegal workers
item.description: A car wash owner in Hastings has been sentenced after illegal workers were repeatedly found at his business, Sussex Police said.

item.title: Police increase patrols in Eldridge Way area of St Leonards
item.description: Police said they are increasing patrols in and around Eldridge Way, St Leonards, near The Ridge, following reports of anti-social behaviour from local residents.

item.title: Police make 18 weekend arrests in Hastings and Rother
item.description: Sussex Police made 18 arrests in Hastings and Rother between 30 October and 1 November, a spokesperson said.

item.title: Man convicted of 18 offences after shop thefts in Hastings
item.description: Tom Marchant, 44, of no fixed address, has been convicted of 18 offences after a series of shop thefts in Hastings, Sussex Police have reported.

item.title: Police appeal to find Orion, 15, last seen in St Leonards
item.description: Police are appealing to the public to help find a missing 15-year-old boy who was last seen in St Leonards on Saturday (31 October).

item.title: New police policy will see illegal e-bikes and e-scooters seized from Sunday
item.description: Sussex Police and Surrey Police have introduced a tougher policy under which riders caught using illegal electric vehicles in public could have their vehicles seized and destroyed.

item.title: Police appeal after car and horse rider incident in Bexhill
item.description: Rother Police are appealing for information following a road traffic incident in the Broad Oak Lane area of Bexhill.

item.title: Police step up evening patrols in Rye after reports of anti-social behaviour
item.description: Officers and police community support officers have continued with reassurance patrols in Rye and the surrounding areas, with particular attention given to Love Lane, Sussex Police has said.

item.title: Police launch Safer Town Centres campaign and new ASB powers
item.description: Sussex Police is launching a month-long Safer Town Centres campaign across Sussex, backed by new powers to tackle anti-social behaviour, a police spokesperson said.

item.title: Portslade man jailed for eight years for rape and abusive behaviour
item.description: Paul Savage, 50, of Carlton Terrace, Portslade, was sentenced to eight years' imprisonment at Lewes Crown Court, a Sussex Police spokesperson said.

item.title: Police appeal after catapults reported in Bexhill's Egerton Park
item.description: Police are appealing for information after reports of animals being targeted with catapults in Egerton Park, Bexhill-on-Sea.

item.title: Man found not guilty of sex offences on Camber Sands beach
item.description: A man from Kent has been found not guilty of a number of sexual offences against a woman on Camber Sands.

item.title: Manhunt for escaped prisoner with links to Sussex
item.description: Police have launched a manhunt for a convicted prisoner with links to Sussex who escaped from a medical facility in South London on Friday.

item.title: Police secure closure order for Hastings property
item.description: Officers from the Hastings Neighbourhood Policing Team have secured a Closure Order for a property in Cornwallis Terrace, Hastings.
